parsed.rationale: Both records carry all context flags as false (is_test=false, is_mock=false, is_codegen=false, is_sample_app=false), yet the files are located under test directories ('Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift' and 'WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift') and the type name 'MockDiscogsEntityResolver' strongly implies these are test-support mock objects. The two mocks live in separate packages ('Metadata' and 'app:iOS') and serve distinct test suites (markup parsing vs. formatter tests), so their structural coincidence is a natural consequence of both needing a minimal stub of the same protocol method rather than a true unintentional duplication. Consolidating them into a shared test helper would introduce a cross-package test dependency that is unlikely to be warranted given the narrow scope of each mock.
